title: Booking card
summary: One booking with a business, pinned at the top of the chat with it and listed in agenda-my-bookings: service, person, date, time and status, with Adicionar ao calendário, Remarcar and Cancelar (ADR 0102).

businessId.description: Matrix ID of the company account.

serviceId.description: The Catálogo item of kind service.

serviceName.description: The service name, from the business's public services or the owner's catalogue.

agendaName.description: Name of the person or station.

start.description: Start, shown in the phone's time zone and locale.

customerUserId.description: The customer's Matrix ID. Absent for a name-only booking.

customerName.description: Name-only customer (encaixe). Absent for a signed-in customer.

ownerMode.description: true on the company account: it shows the customer and opens agenda-owner-booking instead of the customer actions.

canCancel.description: true for held, requested and confirmed before the end.

addToCalendar.effect: Writes a local .ics file with the start, end, bipe_agenda_calendar_title (service and business name) and shares it to the system calendar. Nothing goes to the server.

reschedule.effect: Opens agenda-book with moving set to this booking.

cancel.effect: Asks bipe_agenda_cancel_confirm with bipe_agenda_cancel_confirm_body, then POST /v1/businesses/{business}/agenda/bookings/{id}/cancel. cancellation_window_closed shows bipe_agenda_error_cancel_window.

openOwner.effect: Owner mode: opens agenda-owner-booking for this booking.

notes: iOS and Android draw the card the same way (ADR 0102, ADR 0031).
The card is not a room event. It refreshes when the chat opens, when the app comes to the front and after each action.
A name-only booking (encaixe) has no card on the customer side (ADR 0100).
